integrity: The quantified claim is proved symbolically. The accompanying exhaustive finite program is a stress test of the explicit construction on small cases and is not used as a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem proves null-homotopy and path connectedness of the finite mapping space, not contractibility. It applies to source posets with no chain of three distinct points and targets that are ordinal sums of at least three nonempty antichains; the two-level case can fail.
title: Three target levels null-homotope every map from a height-two finite space
